column1: # The arrays the recompiled game uses at a new address (tools/recomp/rebase.py), sized for four
# players. From the decomp's docs/FOUR_HUMANS.md 7 and FOUR_PLAYERS.md 4.4 / 5.1 (its port variant's
# config/US/port_variant_arrays.tsv). retail_va, retail_size: the retail storage (left unused);
# entries x entry_bytes: the new size. Not moved yet: hudOrderTables (its HUD count is the middle
# dimension). The radar arrow sprites: retail's hudRadarArrowsLoad reaches Down/Left/Right as UpSprites[2..7]
# (their own addresses, so each moves with its array); HUDs 3-4's copies come from vplus/four.c.
# viewModeTable: rows 9-15 free for the port (quarter views, vplus/four.c).
